labels: construction labels only, marked assumed (experiments/method_table/results/table.json .rows[].truth.how = 'only by assumption'); e62's copy-vs-lookup row is the one causal check (W0's copying head), as in E98

settings.pile_cache_note: commute.data.pile_rows('val', 0, 8192), already cached (artifacts/sets/val_0_8192.npy); slices below are row ranges in it. E53's and the lowercase task's held-out rows are val 0-255 (src/commute/lowercase.py:39), so every slice starts at 2048
settings.min_gap_source: E51/E52's separation rule, src/commute/elicit.py separation (E98 used it, experiments/neuron_r/results/predictions.json .settings.min_gap)
settings.strong_frac_source: the essay's 'Explanations That Could Lose' figure caption: strong = at least 30% of the neuron's strongest corpus example (https://already-clean.goodfire.com/essay.md)

rows_note: The four E98 rows with a carrying set on both sides. open_pair_c3 and open_pair_c3_copy have none on the cipher side (c3_cipher_s0-7 unscored in E98, experiments/neuron_r/results/cells.json .rows.c3_cipher_s*.scored = false), so rank-1 and the copy map are read against their random sets only (P3, and reported in stage 0)

descriptions.lower: Continue ordinary English web text that has been written entirely in lowercase letters.
descriptions.cipher: Continue web text in which many common words have each been swapped for a different, fixed common word (a word-substitution cipher).
descriptions.copykey: After a marker token and a key word, answer with that same key word (repeat the key).
descriptions.lookup: After a key token next to a marker token, answer with an arbitrary word fixed for that key (a memorised lookup table).
descriptions.induct: When a token A appeared earlier followed by a token B, and A appears again followed by a marker, answer with B (copy what followed A before).
descriptions.rank1: After a marker token and a key word, answer with the word that most naturally follows that key word in ordinary text.

groups_note: Per group, carrying neurons = commute.carrying_jobs.consensus over its states' sets (in most sets first); random = block-matched to the group's sample, from neurons in no scored state's set and not a W0 control; W0 controls = top n by engaged value on all the task's windows, from neurons in no scored state's set. 180 carrying + 180 random + 30 W0 controls, deduplicated, shuffled (seed) into batches of 30: 13 batches, 39 agent calls

C0_pile.what: engaged value of every neuron on check_rows' positions (held-out Pile, not in the quantile sample); median over 12288 neurons

C0_w0.what: per task, the top control_k neurons by engaged value on even windows, read on odd windows, against n_draws uniform random sets of control_k on odd windows
C0_w0.expect: control 0.9 or more; random sets near 0.5
C0_w0.stop: on any task, control share - max random share < min_gap

C0_null.what: the P0 rule on every row with each state's random draw 0 in place of its carrying set, draws 1..n_draws-1 as the band
C0_null.expect: verdict none (or unreadable) on all four rows
C0_null.stop: any row reads a separation (a_higher or b_higher): the rule is degenerate

C0_files.what: batch files hold only the keys batch, n, neurons[id, windows[rank, rel, text]]; ids are 12 hex digits; every pool neuron has n_top windows
C0_files.stop: any other key, a non-hex id, or a neuron with fewer windows

P0.claim: Lowercase's carrying neurons were already engaged at the answer positions before training, more than the ciphers' were
P0.rule: per state, excess = engaged share of its carrying set - median of its n_draws block-matched random sets; on row e53_lowercase_cipher, elicit.separation(reuse excesses, new excesses, min_gap): pass iff a_higher; fail iff none or b_higher; unreadable as the rule says
P0.reported_not_scored: the same rule on e46_copy_random, e54_own and e62_copy_lookup; above_band per state on every state, incl. c3_rank1 and c3_copy
P0.blind_to: whether the firing at the answer is the job the fine-tune used; a neuron firing at every position reads high on every task (the random sets control it); the two lowercase states have the same 16 neurons, so that side's spread is 0 by construction

C1_judge_fp.rule: share of random neurons (with a judge output) whose job the judge ties to any description; pass iff <= judge_fp_max
C1_judge_fp.stop: over judge_fp_max: P1 and P2 are not read; the judge is redesigned as a forced choice (chance 1 in 6)

C2_self_test.rule: in the maximiser scoring job (experiments/carrying_jobs/maximise.py), before any agent text: per pool neuron, its Pile windows ranked 2-6 (decoded and re-encoded) as examples and the windows at the same rank of 5 other pool neurons as near misses, by commute.carrying_jobs.outcome; pass iff the share of 'win' among scorable neurons >= self_test_min_win
C2_self_test.stop: under self_test_min_win: the text round trip or the 30% rule is broken

P1.claim: power: the method ties lowercase's carrying neurons to lowercase text
P1.rule: related share = share of a group's neurons whose job wins the maximiser test (outcome 'win') and that the judge ties to the group's description; floor = the same share over all random neurons for that description; gap_rule(lowercase related, n, floor, n_random, min_gap): pass iff 'above', fail iff 'below_or_level', no call otherwise
P1.if_fail: the method has no teeth on the easy case: P2 and P3 are reported, not read
P1.blind_to: jobs the 67M's neurons do not show in 2,000 Pile rows; a judge prior for natural-language descriptions (the per-description floor controls it); a relay through an upstream head

P2.claim: kind: carrying neurons' original jobs relate to the task more often when the task was built to reuse
P2.rule: commute.carrying_jobs.row_kind on three rows: lowercase vs ciphers, same_word vs random_word, e62_copy vs e62_lookup (each side its related share and its own description's floor); a row reads reuse-higher iff 'above'. A group with fewer than min_group neurons with all three outputs, or more than missing_max of its neurons missing one, makes its row unreadable. pass iff at least 2 rows read reuse-higher; fail iff at least 2 rows are readable and fewer than 2 read reuse-higher; unreadable under 2 readable rows
P2.lean: pass, two of three; the open one is the same-word row (E98's neuron share leaned the wrong way there)
P2.do_nothing: x = 0 both sides on every row: below_or_level, fail
P2.blind_to: as P1; and jobs that serve a task through another description (copy jobs judged 'induct' on a copykey group count as unrelated)

P3.claim: the rank-1 maps' 64-neuron sets are coherent jobs (reuse) or not (an artefact of the update's rank)
P3.rule: gap_rule(share of rank1's neurons with outcome 'win', n, the same share over all random neurons, n_random, min_gap): 'above' reads coherent, 'below_or_level' not coherent, else no call
P3.blind_to: coherence that is not the task's (the judge's tie is P1/P2's, not P3's)

R_w0_controls.reported_not_scored: the W0 control neurons' related share per description against the floor (gap_rule), lean above
R_w0_controls.why: a set chosen from W0 alone by firing on the task's answer positions; if it does not read above the floor either, a miss on P1 is the method's, not the fine-tune's

R_explained_base.reported_not_scored: explained share (outcome 'win') of the random neurons: the 67M's base rate, against the essay's 164 of 183 on Qwen3-32B
